title: The Stapleton | Entire Home | 9 min to Broadway!
description:
Welcome to The Stapleton! We’ve newly renovated and our townhome is located in The Nations just 5 miles from bustling Broadway, 5 miles from the famous 12 South, 3 miles to the Gulch, and 10 miles to Nashville International Airport. Next to several note worthy breweries and restaurants including Nashville native Hattie B’s, and Fat Bottom Brewery! The perfect location for your Nashville stay!

The space
Cozy and comfortable, we pride ourselves on keeping it well designed but still feels like home! Make yourself some morning coffee and enjoy looking off the back deck while you sit with friends and family. Sit around a fire (inside or out) and share memories while you make new ones in Nashville!

Guest access
Full access! Just keep in mind the driveway space is shared.
